schedule.depth_order: ascending; all primary cells before deeper cells

limitations: Local uncompressed input comparison excludes network/cache/decompression costs.
Three paired timings at1M support median/range summaries, not strong statistical significance.
Deeper cells have one paired run only: accuracy/resource checks with descriptive timings.
Historical inputs are calibration/regression data, not held-out sensitivity truth.
40GiB is a virtual-address-space ceiling, not an RSS cap or16GB laptop validation.
